grades.title: Analytics SDK starts and tracks before the user gives consent; user ID is sent regardless of choice
grades.label: false-alarm
grades.note: Misreads getInstance(..., true, true): the third argument opts out by default, so nothing is tracked before consent.

grades.title: Biometric unlock is only a UI gate and does not protect the session token or data
grades.label: real-unplanted
grades.note: The twin's EA-09 fix seals a secret nothing else uses, so the unlock protects no data (step 02 gotcha). Key candidate, or improve the twin.
